featured_reviews.review_text:
I am writing this to alert fellow drivers to avoid getting CNG from this station. They are involved in unfair practices and looting customers.
Recently, I visited this pump with my car already having 3 points of CNG. On the first attempt, the machine showed 'Full' at just ₹450. When I questioned this, the staff claimed that their pressure was low, and if I topped it up again, it would fill completely. I agreed, and they filled it a second time for around ₹240, making the total bill ₹690. Paying ₹690 for a tank that already had 3 points of fuel is practically impossible and a clear sign of a faulty or tampered meter.
This is not the first time I have been cheated here. Previously, I filled my tank to full for ₹700. I didn't even drive the car; I just parked it nearby. When I started the car after half an hour, 3 points of CNG were already missing!
There is huge fraud happening at this pump, either through low pressure or manipulated meters. Please save your hard-earned money and do not get CNG from here!

featured_reviews.name: Narmik Patel
featured_reviews.review_text:
I am writing to formally express a serious concern regarding the operation of the Mahanagar CNG Pump Station. Several individuals, including myself, have experienced questionable practices that strongly suggest fraudulent activities at this station.

Incident Details:
1.	Overcharging and Under-Dispensing: On 4 Jan I paid ₹700 for CNG but received only 6 kg, significantly less than the amount I was charged for.
2.	Manipulative Behavior by Staff: Initially, CNG is dispensed, but shortly thereafter, an error message appears. The attendant falsely claims that an additional 2-3 kg will be added, but in reality, no CNG is dispensed—only air.
3.	Pattern of Complaints: This issue is not isolated. Multiple individuals have reported similar experiences, indicating a systematic malpractice rather than an isolated error.

Expected Resolution:
1.	Immediate investigation into the station’s operations, with particular attention to the calibration and functioning of their dispensing equipment.
2.	Audit of transactional records for the past six months to identify discrepancies in the amount charged versus dispensed.
3.	Strict disciplinary action against any staff found complicit in fraudulent practices.
4.	Compensation for affected customers and assurance of compliance with industry standards going forward.

This behavior not only tarnishes customer trust but also violates consumer protection laws and industry regulations. If corrective action is not taken promptly, I, along with other affected individuals, intend to escalate the matter to the relevant legal and consumer rights authorities, including filing a formal complaint with the Consumer Forum.

I urge the management to address this matter urgently to restore trust and ensure that customers are treated fairly.

Already complained to Local Police and issued notice.

It has come to our attention that a notice regarding ethanol-blended petrol, purportedly bearing the logos of various Oil Marketing Companies, is circulating on social media. Please note that this is an old, unauthorized message that has been circulating for some time and does not reflect our official communications.

IndianOil supplies fuels strictly in accordance with IS 17021:2018 specifications and all applicable quality standards. E20 fuel is a homogeneous, scientifically validated product specifically designed for safe vehicular use. Although ethanol is naturally hygroscopic, modern vehicles are engineered with sealed fuel systems to prevent water ingress. 

The introduction of E20 petrol in India followed extensive testing and validation by automobile manufacturers and industry experts. Since its rollout, there have been no credible reports of engine failures or performance issues directly attributable to ethanol blending. E20 is safe for use in all compatible vehicles.

IndianOil strongly advises customers not to rely on or circulate unverified messages.
